remarks: Welcome to 75 Bowman, a beautifully expanded ranch/split-level home nestled in the highly desirable King Merritt Association. This thoughtfully designed residence offers a spacious, sun-filled layout that effortlessly blends relaxation and entertainment. With primary suites on both the first and second floors, you have the flexibility to choose the space that best fits your needs. The family room and entertainment kitchen, with sliding doors leading to the pool, create the perfect setting for gatherings. Outside, the yard and inviting pool provide a serene backdrop for hosting or unwinding. Located in a vibrant community with convenient access to local amenities, this home offers an exceptional blend of comfort and lifestyle. Don't miss your chance to make 75 Bowman your private retreat!
